title: On Staying behind when the rest went
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：stay　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stay 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the observer ① stayed behind when the rest went without complaint, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② stays behind when the rest went with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ stay behind when the rest went at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ stayed behind when the rest went before — a line in the log for November 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Staying behind when the rest went without complaint, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ stay open until the last guest left with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Stay open until the last guest left at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ stays open until the last guest left without complaint every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ stayed behind when the rest went again when nobody else would.

⑩ To stay behind when the rest went, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody stays behind when the rest went with great care again and somebody must stay behind when the rest went without complaint all over again.

stay 意为“留下”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯留下别人走了独自留下”，此处为不定式 to stay behind when the rest went。
stay 意为“留下”，观测记录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人留下过，故用过去完成时 had stayed。

stay 意为“保持”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去保持开到最后一位客人走了”，should ever 之后用原形 stay open until the last guest left。
stay 意为“保持”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻保持开到最后一位客人走了（stay open until the last guest left at once），以后再也不要提起。

stay 意为“留下”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要留下别人走了独自留下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和观测站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 stay 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the observer stayed behind when the rest went without complaint, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer stays behind when the rest went with great care whenever the observatory asks.
Staying behind when the rest went without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever stay open until the last guest left with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory stays open until the last guest left without complaint every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother stayed behind when the rest went again, and the observatory remembered that half.
